name: Execute Tool Calls
description: Dispatch each tool call in the list to the ToolExecutor and collect results. Each call is routed to the appropriate registered tool handler; results are returned in the same order as the input calls.

inputs.name: tool_executor_ref
inputs.description: Reference to the ToolExecutor instance or config

outputs.name: tool_results
outputs.description: Ordered list of tool execution results, one per input call

outputs.name: failed_calls
outputs.description: Tool calls that errored; empty on full success
